releases.notes:
# OpenClient Socialization Update

This update introduces a new social and notification foundation for OpenClient, along with the first server integrations.

## What's new

### Notifications

- New animated in-game notification system
- Notification sounds
- Module enable/disable notifications
- Multiple notification types and icons
- Support for notifications generated by server integrations

### Server Integrations

- Added the new Server Integration system
- Initial CubeCraft support
- CubeCraft party invite notifications
- CubeCraft kill notifications
- Individual settings for integration events
- Integration settings are saved between sessions
- Foundation for adding support for more servers in future updates

### Discord Rich Presence

- Added Discord RPC support
- Displays whether you're in the main menu, singleplayer, or multiplayer
- Supported servers can display their actual server name through the integration system

### Settings

- Added the foundation for global OpenClient settings
- Added integration settings
- Settings and integration preferences are saved and restored automatically

### Internal

- Reworked the module architecture
- Added a universal Module base class

## OpenClient Alpha v0.0.6

### Features
- Fully working HUD Editor with drag-and-drop
- Mods List
- JSON configs for module positions, enabled states and settings
- New module settings system
  - Boolean settings
  - Slider settings

### Modules
- Armor Status
- Biome Display
- Coordinates
- FPS
- Keystrokes
- Potion HUD
- Sprinting HUD
- Target HUD
- Ping *(doesn't work properly yet)*

### New in v0.0.6
Added configurable settings for:
- Armor Status
- Biome Display
- Coordinates
- Target HUD

Module settings are automatically saved to JSON configs.
